query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Shopify on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Shopify, 17 November 2026

**Window covered:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Sources are the search results provided; nothing else was used.

## Financial performance
- Shopify reported Q3 2026 results (quarter ended 30 September 2026) with 32% revenue growth (32% in constant currency) and a 22% free cash flow margin (https://www.shopify.com/news/shopify-q3-2026-financial-results). The same figures appear in the investor press release (https://www.shopify.com/investors/press-releases/shopify-sustains-rapid-growth-revenue-32-and-free-cash-flow).

## Product launches
- The Fall '26 Edition opens Shopify's catalog, cart, and checkout to any agent or app, and adds new tools for building and securing apps and storefronts (https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-developer, 28 Oct 2026).
- Shopify's merchant-facing Fall '26 coverage is at https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-merchant (28 Oct 2026).

## Platform changes and deadlines
- Shopify's changelog lists the IP allowlist as required for every public app by 20 November 2026, or by 12 November for apps using bulk operations. It is marked as an action-required breaking change, and ASN support now covers serverless hosting (https://shopify.dev/changelog, 5 Nov 2026).

## Customer evidence
- Shopify published Plus case studies on 24 October 2026. Dermalogica reported a 9% increase in store conversion after its September 2025 Horizon theme launch. Staples Canada ran more than four times as many website promotions during Black Friday and Cyber Monday after moving to Shopify Plus (https://www.shopify.com/enterprise/blog/brands-using-shopify-plus). These are older results shared in a recent post, not new deals.

## Offers
- A third-party page advertises three months of Shopify for $1/month, valid until 30 November 2026 (https://www.demandsage.com/shopify-free-trial). I could not confirm this offer on a Shopify page, so treat it as unverified.

## Headcount (undated)
- A company profile lists 30,025 employees, up 5,330 (21.6%) over the year and up 170 in the latest month (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/yIg9BumgrtmF). The profile is undated, so I cannot place this figure within the 30-day window.

## Hires and deals
- I found no sources for new executive hires or new partnership or acquisition deals in the window.

## Open questions
1. Which of our apps are affected by the IP allowlist requirement, and can we meet the 12 November (bulk ops) or 20 November deadline, given that the meeting falls between them?
2. With catalog, cart, and checkout now open to agents and apps, what access controls and data-security safeguards does Shopify provide, and how should we plan our integrations?
3. Is the $1/month three-month offer an official Shopify program, and if so, what terms apply after it expires on 30 November?
